rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the shore or beach by the sea.

example.english: We spent the whole afternoon playing on the strand.
example.traditional: 我哋成個下午都喺沙灘度玩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seng4 go3 haa6 ng5 dou1 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 waan2

rows.note: Use this for one long, thin individual strand such as a strand of spaghetti, hair, or thread.

example.english: There is a strand of hair stuck to your noodles.
example.traditional: 你碗麵上面黐住一條頭髮。
example.jyutping: nei5 wun2 min6 soeng6 min6 ci1 zyu6 jat1 tiu4 tau4 faat3

rows.note: Use this for a strand or ply that forms part of twisted thread, rope, or a group of braided wires.

example.english: One strand of hemp thread inside this rope has snapped.
example.traditional: 呢條麻繩入面有一股麻線斷咗。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 maa4 sing2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 gu2 maa4 sin3 tyun5 zo2
